## Checklist

- [ ] `node gate.mjs` passes.
- [ ] Tests are added or updated (a bug fix carries its regression test).
- [ ] No test assertion is changed or deleted to get green.
- [ ] AI assistance is disclosed here, and a human verified the work.
- [ ] A guide change updates the worked examples and README to agree.
